system.description:
You can encase a single arm in rock, enabling yourself to strike with hardened punches, while also protecting yourself from direct contact. For the duration of this jutsu, you add +1d6 to your [Unarmed damage] rolls up to twice per turn.

For the duration of this jutsu one of your hands are occupied and cannot be used to make Hand Seals (HS) or use Chakra Seals (CS). Also, when you strike a creature with the encased arm, it does not count as direct contact with them.

Alternatively, you can use the stone to create a weapon made from stone in a shape and design of your choice which you have proficiency with. The weapon has all properties of the original weapon, but it deals 1d6 of the weapons original damage type + 1d6 earth damage, in place of its normal damage die. If the weapon has the Light weapon property, its damage die instead becomes just 1d6 earth damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. When this jutsu is cast at B-Rank, increase the earth damage by 1d6. When this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the earth damage by 1d6.
